# SYNTHETIC TEST MATERIAL — not an Indian statute, judgment or legal authority

This invented classroom document tests retrieval and citations only. Its content must never appear in normal legal research.

1. Classroom consent rule
The fictional classroom employer records written consent before a student changes a demonstration shift, provided that the student can withdraw consent without penalty. This is a synthetic test rule, not law.

2. Demonstration payment record
The fictional payment record contains the student's chosen alias and the recorded demonstration date. No amount, deadline or legal entitlement is created by this fixture.

3. Exception for classroom interruptions
The classroom exercise pauses when an instructor announces a safety interruption. The consent rule does not prevent a safety pause. This exception is only synthetic test material.
